notes: Retailer spec table (Markertek), cross-confirmed by consistent specs on B&H, Full Compass, Amazon and Markertek's manufacturer-sourced PDF spec sheet listing; direct fetch of audinate.com and B&H product pages was blocked (403), so this is a secondary rather than primary manufacturer source, hence medium confidence. Connector layout (1x RJ45, 1x XLR-M for AES3 out, 1x XLR-F for AES3 in) is consistent across all sources. RJ45 grade set to eth-100m as a conservative floor since Dante AVIO adapters use 100Mbps Fast Ethernet (no gigabit spec published for this small-form-factor AVIO line); this is an inference, not an explicit manufacturer statement. Unit is a desktop/pigtail-style adapter, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. No separate power connector exists — device is powered exclusively via PoE on the RJ45 port (802.3af Class 1).

ports.name: AES3 In
ports.note: XLR female; stereo AES3/EBU digital audio input pair, 110 ohm balanced, up to 96kHz/24-bit

ports.name: AES3 Out
ports.note: XLR male; stereo AES3/EBU digital audio output pair, 110 ohm balanced, up to 96kHz/24-bit

ports.name: Dante/Network
ports.note: Dante audio-over-IP network connection; also supplies Class 1 802.3af PoE power to the unit (no separate power connector)
